about: A message with when "now" to an idle launched agent that cannot steer (as OpenCode): it starts a turn.
comment: A bridge case: one request as the page side sends it ({contract, id, method, params}), against state-example.json, with the rights in granted. A result is compared whole; an error by its code only, since its message is free (one sentence that says what to do). A case may carry patch: per agent id, keys that replace those of state-example.json for this case only.
